general.descriptionTextModule: Manage fixed monthly shipping dates per supplier

list.ruleSummary: Arrival: {occurrence} {arrivalWeekday} · Deadline: {offset} days before, {time} · Shipping: following {shipWeekday}

detail.helpActive: Inactive profiles hide the fixed shipping date for all assigned products – the default delivery time is shown again.
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key (lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only). Can be written by the ERP (ERPNext/WeClapp) into the custom field of the product or manufacturer.
detail.errorTechnicalName: Only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ are allowed.
detail.helpArrival: Default: last Wednesday of the month.
detail.errorDeadlineTime: Please use the format HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
detail.labelShipWeekday: Shipping to customer: next weekday after arrival
detail.helpExcludedMonths: Comma-separated month numbers (1–12), e.g. "8, 12" for company holidays in August and December. These months are skipped.
detail.errorExcludedMonths: Only month numbers from 1 to 12, not all months.
detail.errorSave: The delivery profile could not be saved. Is the technical name unique?
